title: StringBuilder, Not Concatenation
prompt:
`ConcatReport` builds one big string with `+=` inside the loop —
the quadratic shape. Rewrite it as `Solution.Report(string[] lines)` using a
`System.Text.StringBuilder` so the loop allocates no intermediate strings:

- one line per input, each terminated with `'\n'` (so `lines = ["a","b"]`
  produces `"a\nb\n"`),
- empty input produces `""`,
- and `StringOps.Allocations` must stay at 0 across the whole call (the
  counting helper is provided; call `StringOps.Bump()` never).

```csharp
public static class Solution
{
    public static string Report(string[] lines);   // one line per input, '\n'-terminated
}
// provided: public static class StringOps { int Allocations; Reset(); Bump(); }
```

tests.name: output shape is exact
tests.hint:
Append each line + '
'; empty input appends nothing.

tests.name: no intermediate string allocations
tests.hint: StringBuilder holds the buffer; one ToString at the end (which the harness does not count).

tests.name: long input finishes
tests.hint:
500 lines of 'line-NNN' (7 chars) + '
' = 8 per line, 4000 total — prove the loop is linear by surviving it.
